Privacy Policy

Last updated October 12, 2026

Hoop Network (“we”, “us”) runs hoopnetwork.net, a basketball education site with free video breakdowns, coaching sessions and team access for coaches. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.

Information we collect

  • Contact and inquiry forms: your name, email, optional phone number, the reason for your message, any preferred days or times or city you enter, and the message itself.
  • Email list: your email address if you sign up.
  • Automatic technical data: like most websites, our hosting and the services below may receive your IP address and browser details when you load the site.

We do not ask for payment details on this site, and we do not sell your personal information.

How we use it

  • To reply to your message and to check availability for sessions.
  • To set up team access for coaches and teams.
  • To send Hoop Network updates if you joined the email list. You can ask to be removed at any time.

Where it is stored and who handles it

Form submissions are saved in our database (Supabase) and emailed to us through a form service (Web3Forms). The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Videos play from YouTube or Vimeo, and fonts load from Google Fonts, so those companies may collect basic data, such as your IP address, under their own policies.

Children

This site is for coaches, players and parents. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without a parent’s or guardian’s consent. If you are a parent and believe your child has sent us information, or you want a photo of your child removed from the site, email us and we will take care of it.

Keeping and deleting your information

We keep messages and email-list addresses only as long as needed for the purposes above. To see, correct or delete your information, or to be removed from the email list, email hoopnetwork10@gmail.com.

Changes

We may update this policy and will change the date above when we do.
